value_points: 当天 18 个词汇都进入 Alex 的故事
JSON、CSV 与日志 × 投诉、退换与解决问题 × 测试、构建与部署

segments.en: By day 16, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "JSON" and "CSV" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "I'd like to return this." and "This item is damaged." to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "test suite" and "build job" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.
